strike_trails.design: knight.gd StrikeTrail: an ImmediateMesh strip behind the weapon's EDGE LINE (two points in a bone's frame, inner then outer), sampled every physics tick through the strike's ACTIVE SWING -- its two ends interpolated to the swing's first and last frame exactly -- Catmull-Rom subdivided x6, thinning toward its tail, faded out over 0.15 s after the swing's last frame (the clip's own time while the strike runs). The look: a wash in pale warm white (0.96, 0.92, 0.84) with dry-brush streaks along the stroke and a soft falloff toward its inner edge and its tail; THE RAMP under the scene's sun (two levels, one soft noise-broken edge, the painting's pale blue-violet (0.78, 0.78, 0.88) on the shade side); THE PEN along its outer rim in the gear's ink (0.055, 0.043, 0.063), about 1.4 px, breaking toward the tail. Unshaded, blended, no depth write, no shadow, no fog.
